markscription.theme.title: Syntax theme
markscription.theme.colors.tooltip: Local reading only. Plain code also colors inline code and unhighlighted blocks. Choose colors that contrast with book pages; server-saved colors are unchanged.
markscription.theme.filename.tooltip: JSON files are shared in config/markscription/themes. Use a name like my-theme.json. Export never overwrites an existing file.
markscription.theme.filename.invalid: Use 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit, followed by .json.
markscription.theme.action.tooltip: Choose an action, then Save & Done. Import replaces the color choices with the file's colors; Export shares your choices. Reopen settings after importing to see the new colors.
markscription.theme.failure.details: Settings unchanged. Check the filename, JSON, permissions, and game log. Export requires a new filename.
markscription.config.title: Markscription
markscription.config.markdown.tooltip: Format plain-text written books locally. Turn off to show the original source. Does not change server-formatted books or formatting when signing.
markscription.config.bold.tooltip: Apply bold styling to emphasis. When off, show the text without the Markdown markers.
markscription.config.italic.tooltip: Apply italic styling to emphasis. When off, show the text without the Markdown markers.
markscription.config.strikethrough.toolt: Apply strikethrough styling. When off, show the text without the Markdown markers.
markscription.config.headings.tooltip: Show headings in bold. Independent of the bold emphasis setting.
markscription.config.code.tooltip: Use the uniform font for inline code and code blocks. Turning this off also disables syntax highlighting.
markscription.config.links.tooltip: Color, underline, and enable HTTP/HTTPS links. When off, show only their labels. Existing rich-text click actions are not changed.
Highlight supported syntax in java, javascript/js, python/py, json, mcfunction/minecraft/mccommand, snbt, and toml fenced blocks.
